method: Manual one-host-at-a-time metadata-only survey. The ordinary CLI direct HTTPS route failed in this managed environment. The completed run used the same validator library with a temporary curl transport: all DNS answers must be public; --connect-to pins the proxy CONNECT target to a verified public IP while preserving the URL hostname and TLS certificate verification. The validator controls redirects, 100 KB body limits and 10-second timeouts. Only GETs, no credentials, no Sessions, sign-in or actions. At least one second between hosts. Document hashes are of parsed JSON serialized compactly in Python; no automatic refresh is installed.
sources: The 58 hosts from the 12 November survey
New public hosts listed by PAP Checker and poppy.md, plus exact www hostnames and a Wix example identified during the review
